segments.label: §4 source sentence 1
segments.text: Ich habe eine Zeitlang zwischen dem doppelten Plane geschwankt, die Herausgabe der einzelnen Grammatiken und Wörterbücher, oder die Darstellung der aus den Forschungen über die einzelnen Sprachen gezogenen allgemeinen Folgerungen vorangehen zu lassen.

segments.label: §4 source sentence 2
segments.text: Dies letztere Verfahren hat den Nachtheil, dass der Leser, dem die Hülfsmittel zu dem Studium der einzelnen Sprachen, bei der Seltenheit und der oft sehr unbequemen Einrichtung der vorhandenen, erst geschaffen werden müssen, die Richtigkeit der allgemeinen Behauptungen nur sehr unvollständig zu prüfen im Stande ist.

segments.label: §4 source sentence 3
segments.text: Allein von dem ersteren Verfahren hat mich die Langwierigkeit des Geschäfts, und die Dauer der Zeit, die nothwendig bei der Schwierigkeit der Herausgabe solcher Schriften hätte darüber verfliessen müssen, abgeschreckt.

segments.label: §4 claude rendering 1
segments.text: For a time I wavered between two plans: whether to let the publication of the individual grammars and dictionaries come first, or the presentation of the general conclusions drawn from the investigations into the individual languages.

segments.label: §4 claude rendering 2
segments.text: This latter procedure has the disadvantage that the reader, for whom the aids to the study of the individual languages must first be created, given the scarcity and the often very inconvenient arrangement of those that exist, is in a position to test the correctness of the general assertions only very incompletely.

segments.label: §4 claude rendering 3
segments.text: But I was deterred from the former procedure by the protractedness of the task, and by the length of time that, given the difficulty of publishing such writings, would necessarily have had to elapse over it.

segments.label: §4 muse rendering 1
segments.text: For a time I wavered between the two plans of letting either the publication of the individual grammars and dictionaries, or the presentation of the general conclusions drawn from the researches into the individual languages, come first.

segments.label: §4 muse rendering 2
segments.text: This latter procedure has the disadvantage that the reader, for whom the aids to the study of the individual languages must first be created, given the rarity and the often very inconvenient arrangement of those that exist, is able to test the correctness of the general assertions only very incompletely.

segments.label: §4 muse rendering 3
segments.text: Yet I was deterred from the former procedure by the protracted nature of the undertaking, and by the length of time which, given the difficulty of publishing such writings, would necessarily have had to elapse over it.

segments.label: §4 codex rendering 1
segments.text: For a time I wavered between two plans: to let the publication of the individual grammars and dictionaries come first, or to begin with a presentation of the general conclusions drawn from research on the individual languages.

segments.label: §4 codex rendering 2
segments.text: This latter procedure has the disadvantage that the reader—for whom aids to studying the individual languages must first be created, given the scarcity and often very inconvenient arrangement of those available—is able to examine the correctness of the general assertions only very incompletely.

segments.label: §4 codex rendering 3
segments.text: Yet I was deterred from the former procedure by the protracted nature of the undertaking and the length of time that would necessarily have elapsed in carrying it out, given the difficulty of publishing such works.

segments.label: §4 synthesis rendering 1
segments.text: For a time I wavered between two plans: publishing the individual grammars and dictionaries first, or first presenting the general conclusions drawn from research into the individual languages.

segments.label: §4 synthesis rendering 2
segments.text: The latter course has the disadvantage that the reader can check the correctness of the general claims only very imperfectly. The resources needed for studying the individual languages must first be created for the reader, since those available are scarce and often very inconveniently arranged.

segments.label: §4 synthesis rendering 3
segments.text: But I was deterred from the former course by the lengthy nature of the undertaking and the length of time that carrying it out would necessarily have required, given the difficulty of publishing such works.

segments.label: §4 revised rendering 1
segments.text: For a time I wavered between two plans: publishing the individual grammars and dictionaries first, or first presenting the general conclusions drawn from the research into the individual languages.

segments.label: §4 revised rendering 2
segments.text: The latter course has the disadvantage that the reader can check the correctness of the general claims only very incompletely: resources for studying the individual languages must first be created for them, given the rarity and often very inconvenient arrangement of those that exist.

segments.label: §4 revised rendering 3
segments.text: But I was deterred from the former course by the protracted nature of the undertaking and the length of time that, given the difficulty of publishing such works, would necessarily have elapsed in the process.

decision.authority: coordinator under D016; English review pending
decision.question: Order of presentation and publication
decision.resolution: Keep the two alternatives and their order explicit. Restore definite research; conclusions (Folgerungen) are distinct from the claims (Behauptungen) to be checked in sentence2.

decision.authority: coordinator under D016; English review pending
decision.question: Resources, reader and extent of checking
decision.resolution: Preserve the explanatory connection, resources still to be created for the reader, rarity and arrangement of existing resources, and only very incomplete checking. Do not turn incompleteness into total inability or defective quality.

decision.authority: coordinator under D016; English review pending
decision.question: Protracted undertaking and unrealized publication delay
decision.resolution: Keep both coordinated deterrents, the publication-difficulty adjunct within the time clause, and the counterfactual necessary lapse of time. Publishing remains locally provisional within Herausgabe’s range.

decision.question: The split into two sentences turns the subordinated relative clause into a free-standing assertion with no connective. The link between the reader's inability to check and the missing aids is left to juxtaposition, and the second sentence is no longer visibly inside the stated disadvantage. The brief allows re-division only if the relations remain explicit. No propositional content is falsified, and the dative 'dem' is correctly kept as 'for the reader'.
decision.resolution: Join the English blocks with a colon so the need to create resources explicitly explains the limited checking within the stated disadvantage. Preserve the beneficiary through singular they referring to the reader.

decision.question: Three small lexical shifts. (a) 'needed' has no counterpart in the German. (b) 'imperfectly' for 'unvollständig' moves from completeness of checking to quality of checking. (c) 'since' makes the circumstantial 'bei' fully causal, and 'scarce' (few exist) is slightly less exact than 'rare' (hard to come by) for 'Seltenheit'. None changes the claim.
decision.resolution: Remove the added needed; replace imperfectly with incompletely to retain extent. Use given for bei, rarity for Seltenheit and those that exist for the existing resources.

decision.question: 'from research into the individual languages' drops the definite article. The source points to a specific body of investigations (in context, those underlying this work); the English reads as research in general.
decision.resolution: Restore the definite the research, referring to the investigations underlying these conclusions, without inserting a possessor.

decision.question: (a) 'that carrying it out would necessarily have required' recasts time elapsing over the business as time required by carrying it out. This resolves 'darüber' as 'in carrying it out' and loses the nuance of delay; the necessity and counterfactual are preserved. (b) The trailing 'given the difficulty of publishing such works' could be read as attaching to 'was deterred'. In the German it sits inside the relative clause and grounds why the time would necessarily have had to pass.
decision.resolution: Restore time elapsing in the process and place the publication-difficulty adjunct inside its relative clause. Necessarily and would have preserve the modal and unrealized temporal relation without implying that the delay actually occurred.

decision.question: The split into two English sentences leaves the link between the reader's limited ability to check the claims and the need first to create study aids implicit. In the German, that need is embedded as a relative clause characterizing the reader within the single disadvantage clause.
decision.resolution: Use an explanatory colon joining the limited checking and resource need; the relation is explicit rather than left to sentence juxtaposition.

decision.question: 'Very imperfectly' suggests defective quality of checking, whereas 'sehr unvollständig' denotes the incomplete extent to which checking is possible.
decision.resolution: Use only very incompletely, preserving the completeness limitation rather than a claim that the checking is defective.

decision.question: 'Those available' can suggest ready availability. 'Der vorhandenen' refers more neutrally to the existing or extant aids, whose scarcity is part of the point.
decision.resolution: Use those that exist, referring to resources; avoid a suggestion of ready availability. Retain rarity and inconvenient arrangement.
